# KVM Parity Conformance — VMCB12 Test Vectors
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
#
# Copyright (c) 2026 The FreeBSD Project Contributors.
# All rights reserved.
#
# Format (one vector per line):
#   ID|FIELD_NAME|OFFSET|BITS|EXPECTED_VALUE|MASK|CATEGORY
#
#   ID              - stable identifier
#   FIELD_NAME      - architectural VMCB12 field name (AMD APM Vol. 2,
#                     section 15.5 "VMCB Layout")
#   OFFSET          - hex offset within the 4-KiB VMCB page
#                     (per AMD APM Table 15-7)
#   BITS            - decimal number of significant bits in field
#   EXPECTED_VALUE  - expected L2-viewable value (with MASK applied)
#   MASK            - bitmask applied before comparison
#   CATEGORY        - MUST_PASS | KNOWN_DIFF
#
# CATEGORY semantics:
#   MUST_PASS   - VMCB12 field must round-trip L1<->L2 unchanged
#   KNOWN_DIFF  - documented diff vs KVM in PARITY.md
#
# Source: AMD APM Vol. 2, section 15.5 (VMCB Layout)
# No values copied from KVM source.
#
# VMCB12 is the L1 hypervisor's view of the L2 VMCB during nSVM
# nested virtualization. Layout is 4 KiB; offsets below are taken
# from the AMD APM Table 15-7.
#
# === MUST_PASS: control-area VMCB12 fields (offsets 0x000-0x3FF) ===

# Intercept reads of CR0..CR15 (offset 0x000 - 0x01C, 2 bytes each)
N001|intercept_read_cr0|00000000|16|0000|FFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS

# === MUST_PASS: VMCB12 control fields ===

# IOPM_BASE_PA (offset 0x090, 8 bytes)
N060|iopm_base_pa|00000090|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# MSRPM_BASE_PA (offset 0x098, 8 bytes)
N061|msrpm_base_pa|00000098|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# TSC_OFFSET (offset 0x0A0, 8 bytes)
N062|tsc_offset|000000A0|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# TLB_CTRL (offset 0x0A8, 4 bytes)
N063|tlb_ctrl|000000A8|32|00000000|FFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# V_INTR_MASKING (offset 0x0AC, 4 bytes - actually 1 byte + reserved)
N064|v_intr_masking|000000AC|8|00|FF|MUST_PASS
# Interrupt_shadow (offset 0x0AD, 1 byte)
N065|interrupt_shadow|000000AD|1|00|FF|MUST_PASS
# Interrupt_info (offset 0x0B0)
N070|interrupt_info|000000B0|32|00000000|FFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# EXITCODE (offset 0x0B8)
N071|exitcode|000000B8|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# EXITINFO1 (offset 0x0C0)
N072|exitinfo1|000000C0|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# EXITINFO2 (offset 0x0C8)
N073|exitinfo2|000000C8|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# EXITINTINFO (offset 0x0D0)
N074|exitintinfo|000000D0|32|00000000|FFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS
# NP_ENABLE (offset 0x0D8, 1 byte)
N075|np_enable|000000D8|8|00|FF|MUST_PASS
# SEV_ENABLE, AVIC_ENABLE, etc. (offset 0x0D8 + 1)
N076|enable_bits|000000D8|32|00000000|FFFFFFFF|MUST_PASS

# === MUST_PASS: nested-page-table-related fields (offsets 0x090-0x0F0) ===

# === KNOWN_DIFF: LBR virtualization state (LBR stack) ===
# KVM and bhyve differ in LBR stack virtualization granularity.
# Documented in PARITY.md.
D001|lbr_stack|00000498|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|KNOWN_DIFF

# === KNOWN_DIFF: SEV/SEV-ES state pages ===
# KVM exposes SEV-ES state to L1 differently than bhyve's
# cap-and-mask filter. Documented in PARITY.md.
D002|sev_state|000004A0|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|KNOWN_DIFF

# === KNOWN_DIFF: AVIC backing page ===
# KVM and bhyve differ in how AVIC backing-page address is exposed
# in the VMCB12. Documented in PARITY.md.
D003|avic_backing_page|000004A8|64|0000000000000000|FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF|KNOWN_DIFF
